remarks: New Canaan condo living at its finest! In town location, walking distance to shops, restaurants, entertainment, the train and picturesque Mead Park. Recent updates include a custom new bath including plumbing. In the Kitchen don't miss the new granite countertops, faucet, backsplash, dishwasher 2024 and refrigerator 2024. Wall A/C 2024 in the living room, dual zone recessed lighting, door hardware and hardwood floor refinishing include additional updates. There is hardwood under the carpeting. The condo was upgraded to natural gas with heat control. There is also a water shut off in the condo. Don't miss the view of the courtyard and back door access. Loads of storage including a lower area.
